# Volt Free CSS

- Publisher: Themesberg.
- Source: https://github.com/themesberg/volt-bootstrap-5-dashboard
- Package: `@themesberg/volt-bootstrap-5-dashboard@1.4.1` from the npm registry.
- The downloaded package passed its registry SHA-512 integrity check before extraction.
- Built from the package Sass with Sass 1.47.0, Bootstrap 5.0.2, Chartist 0.11.4 and vanillajs-datepicker 1.2.0.
- Dependency install used `--ignore-scripts`; only the Sass compiler was run.
- MIT license and original copyright are retained in LICENSE.md and volt.css.

The package metadata, source archive, pinned build dependencies and build lock are preserved locally in `recovery/history-restoration-20261027/`.
